central_metaphor: A high-contrast neon cybernetic routing hub that starts as a rigid linear array of 4 server slots (Modulo N) suffering chaotic key collisions, then bends and locks into a 360-degree glowing Hash Ring where data packets orbit clockwise, scale seamlessly with 1/N slice splits, and finally multiply into balanced Virtual Node (vnode) tokens around the circumference.
metaphor_evolution: Bars 1-4: Rigid linear server slots (N=3 to N=4) fracture and scramble all data keys during a modulo rehash. Bars 5-8: The linear bar curves and welds into a fixed 360-degree circular Hash Ring where keys walk clockwise to the first server node. Bars 9-12: A new server node snaps onto the ring arc and smoothly claims only a 1/N slice from its immediate clockwise neighbor while other keys stay locked. Bars 13-16: Sparse nodes cause a glowing red hotspot arc until Virtual Nodes (vnodes) spawn and scatter evenly around the ring for uniform load.
